geometry_programs.name: comp25r2_d01_quarter_bar_long_lift
geometry_programs.rationale: R1 showed a 1/1 long_axis piloti exposes the full 2500m2 ground but reduces GFA to ~3200m2 vs target 4907m2. This child tests a 1/4 long_axis bar (approximately 350-400m2 footprint, narrowest bar on the long parcel axis, NW quadrant) lifted on piloti at rise_ratio=0.20 (one full storey clearance, ~3.8m). The 1/4 footprint concentrates programme into a compact slab, leaving approximately 2150m2 of unobstructed site for surface parking on the SE side adjacent to the permitted vehicle access frontage ([78.23,36.6]->[57.3,0.0]). A 2150m2 surface zone with a 43m frontage edge can accommodate 4 double-loaded rows (16m module) = approximately 50 stalls, satisfying 49 required. Tradeoff: GFA delivered approximately 1/4 base * 5 storeys - piloti = ~4 occupied floors * ~400m2 = ~1600m2 (well below 4907m2 target, -67%; material conflict reported). Inherited 5-storey/3.8m/19m height contract preserved; book_base_volume label=1/4, orientation=long_axis per path book:path:2c5965d4d40f0975213c85479d0e3e213fe5b93d39341d53e95ffc56eecdb28b (1/4 long_axis carve+offset v10, reinterpreted as lift application).

metadata.parking_repair_response: 1/4 long_axis bar lifted on piloti (rise_ratio=0.20, one full storey). Footprint ~350-400m2 leaves ~2150m2 site for SE surface parking. Estimated 4 rows * 13 stalls = 52 stalls satisfies 49-space requirement. Differs from R1 d01 (1/1 long_axis + lift) by using 1/4 base: much less programme, much more ground released.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~1600m2 vs target 4907m2 (-67%); piloti structural column grid unverified; parking count requires remeasurement against delivered shape; ground lobby and vertical circulation unmodelled.

geometry_programs.name: comp25r2_d02_half_short_carve_east
geometry_programs.rationale: R1 used 1/2 long_axis + terrace (NW half bar). This child uses 1/2 short_axis (building occupies half the parcel width, oriented on the short cross-axis, creating a deep NW-to-SW slab) with a carve_void on the east/open side (margin_ratio=0.40). The 1/2 short_axis base occupies the west half of the parcel; carve_void open_side=east removes 40% of the mass volume on the east face, creating a large recessed void opening toward the SE vehicle access frontage. This void in the lower portion of the mass and the east setback opens approximately 1200-1400m2 of SE ground for surface parking. At 43m frontage length, 3 single-loaded rows (11m depth each) = approximately 39 stalls, supplemented by the carved recess as covered parking under cantilevered upper floors = potentially 10-15 additional stalls. Conflicts: combined parking delivery requires remeasurement; carved void reduces GFA to approximately 2500m2 vs 4907m2 target (-49%); east facade articulation may require structural transfer beam not modelled. Inherited 5-storey/3.8m/19m height preserved.

metadata.parking_repair_response: 1/2 short_axis base with carve_void east (margin_ratio=0.40). West half of parcel occupied; 40% east void opens SE face for surface parking access. Approx 39-54 stalls depending on parcel geometry vs SE frontage. Differs from R1 by using short_axis orientation and carve_void without lift.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~2500m2 after carve vs 4907m2 target (-49%); void structural transfer beam not modelled; parking count requires shape remeasurement; short_axis orientation vs parcel shape needs verification.

geometry_programs.name: comp25r2_d03_eighth_short_lift
geometry_programs.rationale: R1 tested 1/1, 1/2, 3/8 base volumes. This child tests 1/8 short_axis: the smallest occupied bar on the short parcel axis, creating a minimal-footprint tower slab (approximately 190-220m2 footprint). Lifted on piloti (rise_ratio=0.20, ~3.8m clearance), this releases approximately 2300m2 of site area for surface parking from the SE access edge. A 2300m2 surface zone at 43m frontage can fit 4-5 double-loaded rows = 52-65 stalls, comfortably satisfying 49 required. The 1/8 short_axis slab reads as a slender civic tower — spatially distinct from R1's 1/1 (full-site) and 3/8 (L-shape) lifted options. Tradeoff: GFA approximately 4 occupied floors * ~200m2 = ~800m2 (severe shortfall vs 4907m2 target, -84%; material conflict reported). 5-storey/3.8m/19m height inherited. Short_axis orientation places the narrow face toward the SE road — civic address differs from long_axis bars.

geometry_programs.name: comp25r2_d04_three_eighth_vert_lift
geometry_programs.rationale: R1 used 3/8 long_axis + lift (L-shape bar in NW quadrant, long axis). This child uses 3/8 vertical: the same L-of-three-octants shape but with vertical orientation, meaning the three cells of the L are distributed vertically (stacked) rather than horizontally. The resulting mass is a compact mid-rise volume (3/8 of parcel area stacked upward, occupying approximately 750m2 of ground across 3/8 of the plan). Lifted on piloti (rise_ratio=0.20, ~3.8m clearance), the ground plane is freed under the piloti and across the remaining 5/8 of the site for parking. The 3/8 vertical orientation places mass more centrally in the parcel, with the 3-octant stack distributed in plan rather than stretched along the long axis — this creates a more compact urban building profile. Estimated available parking area on SE side: approximately 1700-1800m2, fitting 3 double-loaded rows = approximately 39 stalls + single loaded row = ~13 stalls = 52 total. Conflict: GFA from 4 occupied floors * ~750m2 = ~3000m2 vs target 4907m2 (-39%). Height/storey contract preserved at 5/3.8m/19m.

metadata.parking_repair_response: 3/8 vertical lifted on piloti (rise_ratio=0.20). Compact 3-octant vertically-organized mass frees ~1700-1800m2 SE area for parking. Estimated 52 stalls. Differs from R1 d04 (3/8 long_axis) by using vertical orientation: more compact plan, different urban proportion.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: GFA ~3000m2 vs 4907m2 target (-39%); 3/8 vertical mass geometry requires verification; parking count requires shape remeasurement; piloti column grid not modelled.

geometry_programs.name: comp25r2_d05_half_vert_carve_east
geometry_programs.rationale: R1 used 1/1 vertical + courtyard (open courtyard on east, full parcel). This child uses 1/2 vertical + carve_void east. The 1/2 vertical base occupies half the parcel distributed vertically (a compact slab-half over the NW portion of the site). A carve_void with open_side=east and margin_ratio=0.35 removes 35% of the volume on the east face, creating a recessed open zone toward the SE vehicle access frontage. This differs from R1's 1/1 vertical courtyard (which carves through the full parcel ring) by using a 1/2 base — the west half of the parcel remains solid while the east void creates a SE-facing parking recess. Estimated available parking on SE + carved east zone: approximately 1400-1600m2, supporting 3 double-loaded rows = ~39 stalls + single loaded = ~13 stalls = ~52 total. The 1/2 vertical + carve makes a wider, lower proportion than the 1/1 bar — a horizontal reading building rather than a tower, different formal principle from R1. GFA approximately 1/2 base * 5 floors * (1 - 0.35 carve) = ~1630m2 (conflict vs 4907m2 target, -67%). 5-storey/3.8m/19m height preserved.

metadata.parking_repair_response: 1/2 vertical base with carve_void east (margin_ratio=0.35). NW half of parcel occupied; 35% east void carves SE access zone. Estimated ~52 stalls. Differs from R1 d05 (1/1 vertical + courtyard) by using 1/2 base: half-site slab with east void vs full-ring courtyard.

geometry_programs.name: comp25r2_d06_sixteenth_short_lift
geometry_programs.rationale: This child tests the extreme minimal-footprint option: 1/16 short_axis (approximately 95-120m2 footprint, the smallest cell of the parcel grid, oriented on the short cross-axis) lifted on piloti (rise_ratio=0.20, ~3.8m clearance). This is the maximum-ground-release strategy: approximately 2380m2 of site freed for surface parking. At 43m vehicle access frontage, 5 double-loaded rows (16m each, 5*16=80m depth; parcel is approximately 62m wide — fits 3 rows north-south + 2 rows east-west within irregular boundary) = up to 65 stalls, definitively satisfying 49 required. The 1/16 short_axis lifted volume is spatially the most civic-open proposition: almost the entire site reads as a single ground-level public parking and forecourt zone, with one slender tower-pavilion rising above. Tradeoff: GFA approximately 4 occupied floors * ~100m2 = ~400m2 (extreme shortfall vs 4907m2 target, -92%; major conflict reported). This tests the upper bound of parking provision at the cost of programme. 5-storey/3.8m/19m inherited.
